messages.subject: Disconnecting from server without errors
parts:
Hello,
I have a problem with my shinyapp deployed here: https://mvojtek.shinyapps.io/chip-qpcr_app/
When I enter the data and press "Calculate" button, the instance shuts down. The same thing will happen when you double click on "calculate" button.
The log does not show any errors so I have no idea what is going on.
The app is running fine in a local instance.

Could anyone help me please?

Many thanks,
Matus

messages.subject: Re: Disconnecting from server without errors
parts:
Hello Joshua,

Could you explain to me what is a segmentation fault and how to fix it?
I get disconnected when I execute calculations which are pending for Calculate button input. So this might indicate that generating the output is causing the problem. The output in this case is an excel file generated by XLConnect library which was used in the code producing a segmentation fault which you pointed out.
I might try to deploy the app without generating the output file and see whether if disconnects or not to narrow down the problem.

Thank you for help.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Disconnecting from server without errors
parts:
A segmentation fault is when code accesses memory it should not, and the operating system terminates the process as a result.

I need to investigate the two cases of seg fault and see if there is a common thing before I can make a recommendation on fixing or working around, but on the surface they both seem to involve Excel files...
